system.description: A stub of tenement candle the Order of the Seamless Shroud keeps lit for families who lost everyone. Once per day, light it when the party begins a rest: it sheds light 10', the rest cannot be interrupted, and nothing that does not already know where you are finds you by its light. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: Burn it whole when the party begins a Long Rest: the rest cannot be interrupted, and it counts as Downtime for everyone in its light.
system.drawback: The hearth goes cold behind you: every test to avoid an interrupted rest is made with Bane until it is recovered.
system.faction: the Order of the Seamless Shroud

effects.note: the rest cannot be interrupted. It sheds light 10', and nothing that does not already know where you are finds you by its light.
